name: homePos
meaning: placed position; the fish teleports back here in state 0

name: leapOffset
meaning: 489 along the same axis; applied when leap anim 2 ends

name: offscreenTicks
meaning: not-drawn updates in state 0; swims again at > 1

name: disappearDistSq
meaning: DISAPPEAR_DIST squared; XZ distance from home that ends a swim

name: wasOnScreen
meaning: inst.flags & INST_F_DRAWN copied in Render, zeroed in Update
